gamjee_no_business.m: Why you still here? Leave now.

r: I want to help you and the villagers.

gamjee_villagers_known_1.m: Human, why you come here? Gamjee no hurt you if you leave now.
r: I've found the people you captured. You need to let them go.
I want to help you and the villagers.

gamjee_villagers_known_2.m: Captured? No, no! Gamjee protect them! Humans take Gamjee's well, build village. They no ask. They just take. Gamjee keep them safe here. You see, they not hurt.
r: Keeping them in a pit isn't protecting them. It's imprisoning them.

gamjee_villagers_known_3.m: No! Listen! Humans come, take Gamjee's well, leave Gamjee with nothing. Gamjee scared. If Gamjee let them go, they come back, take well again. They no understand, well is life for Gamjee. Please, you help. Tell humans Gamjee no bad. Maybe they listen. Maybe they share well, no fight. You help, no need for hurt.

It's time to make me righteous!

gamjee_villagers_known_fight.m: No! Gamjee protect! If humans come back, they take all. Gamjee alone, scared.

gamjee_villagers_unknown_1.m: Human, why you come here? Gamjee no hurt you if you leave now.

gamjee_villagers_unknown_2.m: Gamjee guard well. Humans come, take Gamjee's well, build village. They no ask. They just take. Gamjee scared. Need protect well. You help Gamjee?
r: You're afraid they'll come back and take more?
I thought I heard somes voices earlier. Have you hurt anybody recently?
Really? I'm not so sure about that, but I'll see about that.
I don't believe you! Prove it.

gamjee_villagers_unknown_attack.m: No! Gamjee protect! If humans come back, they take all. Gamjee alone, scared.
r: I don't believe you! I can't take that risk. This ends now

gamjee_villagers_unknown_peace.m: Yes! Humans take all if no stop. Gamjee alone. If you help, tell humans Gamjee no bad. Maybe they listen. Maybe they share well, no fight. You help, no need for hurt.

echoes_of_enchantment.1: At the Wexlow well, I angered something evil and powerful (named Gamjee, I think) to the point that it pulled me down into the well. I've landed at the well's bottom severely injured, but alive.
echoes_of_enchantment.2: After I landed with a thud at the bottom of the well and being concussed, I began to hear sounds off in the distance. Were they voices? Were they even real? Maybe a symptom of the concussion perhaps?
echoes_of_enchantment.3: After I landed with a thud at the bottom of the well and being concussed, I began to hear sounds off in the distance. Were they voices? Were they even real? Are they the voices of something more sinister?
echoes_of_enchantment.4: The voices I thought I heard earlier seem to be persistent and seemed to be getting louder. It was hard to tell if they're real or just a figment of my imagination.
echoes_of_enchantment.5: Deep inside the well's tunnels, I found eight people being held captive inside a very deep pit.
echoes_of_enchantment.6: I learned that these people are held captive by a troll and they need me to find a way to free them.
echoes_of_enchantment.7: I met the troll named Gamjee and listened to what he had to say.
echoes_of_enchantment.8: In an attempt to help Gamjee and the villagers, I have facilitated a conversation between Gamjee and one of the villagers.
echoes_of_enchantment.9: I killed Gamjee and in doing so, I found a rope that I think might be helpful in freeing those people in that pit.
echoes_of_enchantment.11: I killed Gamjee and in doing so, I realized that I really should go investigate the voices I heard earlier.
echoes_of_enchantment.10: The villagers have been freed. I should visit them back in their village of Wexlow.
echoes_of_enchantment.12: The villagers and Gamjee agreed to a schedule for using the well, ensuring everyone has access to water without conflict. But the villagers are still in the pit.
echoes_of_enchantment.13: After the villagers and Gamjee agreed to a compromise, Gamjee gave me a rope and instructed me to use it to free the remaining villagers in the pit.
echoes_of_enchantment.14: I've visited the people of Wexlow Village after they made it home. They are happy to sleep in their own beds now.
